description: NIST's STC-10, its AP242 e2 edition's solid alone: it reads, but the checker at Full finds three holes of radius 1.75 (f64, f86, f87) and the bore of radius 2.75 they meet (f58), their axes crossing, intersecting away from their shared edges (S5), as it does f60 and f61–f63, where Open CASCADE's reading is valid.
